title: Workflow-R1: Group Sub-sequence Policy Optimization for Multi-turn Workflow Construction
reasoning: The paper focuses on optimizing agentic workflows via a novel reinforcement learning algorithm (GSsPO) and evaluates it using general-purpose QA benchmarks. While the appendix includes a case study involving biblical genealogy (identifying the father of Asher), this is used as an example of multi-turn search and reasoning capability rather than as a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, theology, or ethics.
